skills.name: 化弦为剑
skills.desc:
普攻·弦剑
连续短按或按住普攻，进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成气动伤害。
普攻·弦剑第1段、普攻·弦剑第4段为藏剑式。
普攻·弦剑第2段、普攻·弦剑第3段为执剑式。

重击·弦剑
【琴心】与【剑韵】充满时，解锁重击·弦剑。
长按普攻，消耗耐力施放，造成气动伤害。
施放该技能，消耗所有【琴心】、【剑韵】，进入昙体仙身状态。

空中攻击·弦剑
连续短按或按住普攻，进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成气动伤害。
该技能为执剑式。
施放空中攻击·弦剑第3段落地后，在一定时间内按下普攻，将会施放普攻·弦剑第3段。
处于空中时，共鸣技能替换为空中攻击·弦剑第3段。

空中下落攻击
处于御剑飞行状态时，跳跃替换为空中下落攻击。
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成气动伤害。
不处于昙体仙身状态时，施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻·弦剑第3段。

闪避反击·弦剑
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成气动伤害。
该技能为执剑式。
施放该技能后在一定时间内按下普攻，将会施放普攻·弦剑第4段。

御剑疾行
处于空中时，闪避替换为御剑疾行。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack - Stringblade
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 1 and Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4 are in Sheathed Stance.
Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2 and Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3 are in Drawn Stance.

Heavy Attack - Stringblade
When Qin Heart and Sword Cadence are full, Heavy Attack - Stringblade becomes available.
Hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast this skill, dealing Aero DMG.
Casting this skill consumes all Qin Heart and Sword Cadence and sends Qingxiao into the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Mid-air Attack - Stringblade
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.
After landing from Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.
While in mid-air, Resonance Skill is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

Plunging Attack
While in the Sword Flight state, Jump is replaced by Plunging Attack.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.
While out of the Ephemeral Transcendence state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

Dodge Counter - Stringblade
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4.

Sword Glide
While in mid-air, Dodge is replaced by Sword Glide.

skills.desc:
浮声一刹·行罚

不处于昙体仙身状态时，施放该技能后在一定时间内按下普攻，将会施放普攻·弦剑第4段。

浮声一刹·凌霄
施放普攻·弦剑第2段、普攻·弦剑第3段、闪避反击·弦剑期间，共鸣技能替换为浮声一刹·凌霄。

skills.name: 识海浩渺，尘世万千
skills.nameEn: Sea of Thought, World of Dust
skills.desc:
进入战斗时，获得1层【凝识】。

队伍中的角色直接造成的伤害击败带有心识锁定效果的目标后：
如果清宵没有【凝识】效果，则获得【凝识】效果，且层数与目标的心识锁定层数相同。
如果清宵已有【凝识】效果，且目标的心识锁定层数不小于清宵的【凝识】层数，则使清宵的【凝识】层数变为与目标的心识锁定层数相同。

【凝识】
队伍中的角色对目标造成伤害后，将附加等同清宵的【凝识】层数的心识锁定，该效果对同一目标只能触发1次。
队伍中的角色施放【谐度破坏】时，如果目标有【集谐·偏移】效果，将额外附加1层【集谐·干涉】，该效果对同一目标只能触发1次。
清宵失去意识时，不会继续获得【凝识】效果，同时已有的【凝识】效果失效。
【凝识】层数上限为15，持续30秒。
skills.descEn:
Upon entering combat, gain 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of Gathered Mind.

After damage dealt directly by Resonators in the team defeats a target inflicted with the Mindlock effect:
If Qingxiao does not have the Gathered Mind effect, gain Gathered Mind with stacks equal to the target's Mindlock stacks.
If Qingxiao already has Gathered Mind and the target's Mindlock stacks are no fewer than Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks, Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks will be matched to the target's Mindlock stacks.

Gathered Mind
After Resonators in the team deal damage to a target, inflict Mindlock equal to Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks. This effect can only trigger 1 {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=1} on the same target.
When Resonators in the team cast Tune Break, if the target has Tune Strain - Shifting, additionally inflict 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. This effect can only trigger 1 {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=3} on the same target.
When Qingxiao is knocked out, she can no longer gain Gathered Mind, and any existing Gathered Mind effect becomes inactive.
Gathered Mind stacks up to 15 times and lasts for 30s.

skills.name: 通晓万物，指名破祟
skills.desc:
清宵以下技能对拥有心识锁定的目标造成伤害提升，每层提升2%，前7层每层额外提升5%。
·重击·弦剑、普攻·昙体仙身、闪避反击·昙体仙身、重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身、共鸣解放·天光云影沧澜兴。

每次队伍中的角色对怒涛级或海啸级目标附加【集谐·干涉】后，对目标额外附加1层心识锁定。
skills.descEn:
Qingxiao's following skills deal 2% more DMG per stack of Mindlock on the target, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1}.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Each time after a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on an Overlord Class or Calamity Class target, additionally inflict 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=3} of Mindlock on the target.

skills.name: 改韵易调
skills.desc:
造成气动伤害，施放时获得30点【剑韵】，并获得金声玉振。

金声玉振
施放共鸣技能·浮声一刹·行罚时，可获得30点【琴心】并移除金声玉振。
skills.descEn:
Deal Aero DMG. Casting the skill restores 30 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Sword Cadence and grants Resonant Chime.

Resonant Chime
Casting Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement grants 30 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Qin Heart and removes Resonant Chime.

skills.name: 无相心剑
skills.desc:
昙体仙身
清宵处于昙体仙身状态时，解锁普攻·昙体仙身、闪避反击·昙体仙身。

普攻·昙体仙身
连续短按或按住普攻，进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成气动伤害。
重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身解锁前，该技能伤害倍率提升100%。
可在空中施放。

闪避反击·昙体仙身
成功闪避后一定时间内按下普攻，将会攻击目标，造成气动伤害。
重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身解锁前，该技能伤害倍率提升100%。
可在空中施放。

重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身
【心剑意】充满时，解锁重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身，长按普攻可施放，造成气动伤害。
施放该技能，消耗所有【心剑意】，退出昙体仙身状态。

心识锁定
心识锁定层数上限为15。
每次队伍中的角色对目标附加【集谐·干涉】后，对目标附加1层心识锁定。
目标每拥有1层心识锁定，受到清宵以下技能伤害加深2%，前7层每层额外加深5%。
·重击·弦剑、普攻·昙体仙身、闪避反击·昙体仙身、重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身、共鸣解放·天光云影沧澜兴。

天心空明
进入战斗或施放共鸣解放天光云影沧澜兴时，获得天心空明。
藏剑式/执剑式造成伤害时，获得【琴心】/【剑韵】效率提升100%。
施放重击·弦剑时，对附近的目标附加3层心识锁定，使自身下一次重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身获得强化：伤害倍率提升100%，对目标额外累积偏谐值。切换至其他角色提前结束重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身强化效果。
施放重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身后，移除天心空明。

护体剑光
施放变奏技能·改韵易调或重击·弦剑时，获得1层护体剑光。
护体剑光上限为1层，受到敌方怪物攻击造成的伤害时，可消耗1层护体剑光，使自身免疫打断且受到伤害降低60%，持续1秒。该效果每秒可触发1次。

御剑飞行
处于御剑飞行状态时，将以特殊表现进行移动。
御剑飞行移动期间持续消耗【御剑气劲】。
·施放以下技能后，将进入御剑飞行状态：
御剑疾行、重击·弦剑、空中攻击·弦剑第1段、空中攻击·弦剑第2段、浮声一刹·凌霄、普攻·昙体仙身、闪避反击·昙体仙身、重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身、变奏技能·改韵易调。
·通过以下方式可退出御剑飞行状态：
1. 施放空中攻击·弦剑第3段、空中下落攻击。
2. 触发特定场景交互或探索工具。
3. 回到地面。
4. 切换至其他角色。
5. 【御剑气劲】为空。

清绝剑遁
处于御剑飞行状态时，长按跳跃，可跃起并向前突进一段距离。
御剑飞行期间仅可施放1次清绝剑遁。

【琴心】获取规则
上限100点。
藏剑式造成伤害时，获得【琴心】。
处于昙体仙身状态时，无法获得【琴心】。

【剑韵】获取规则
上限100点。
执剑式造成伤害时，获得【剑韵】。
处于昙体仙身状态时，无法获得【剑韵】。

【心剑意】获取规则
上限100点。
普攻·昙体仙身、闪避反击·昙体仙身造成伤害时，获得【心剑意】。
skills.descEn:
Ephemeral Transcendence
While Qingxiao is in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence and Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence become available.

Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence
When Heart Sword Intent is full, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available. Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill, dealing Aero DMG.
Casting this skill consumes all Heart Sword Intent and ends the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Mindlock
Mindlock stacks up to 15 times.
Each time a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on a target, inflict 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Mindlock on the target.
For each stack of Mindlock on the target, DMG taken from Qingxiao's following skills is Amplified by 2%, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=4}.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Heaven's Clarity
Upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation Billows Beneath Heaven, gain Heaven's Clarity.
When Sheathed Stance/Drawn Stance skills deal damage, the rates at which Qin Heart/Sword Cadence are obtained increase by 100%.
When casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade, inflict 3 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of Mindlock on nearby targets, and enhance the next Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence: its DMG Multiplier is increased by 100% and it builds additional Off-Tune Level on the target. Switching to another Resonator ends the Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence enhancement.
Casting Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence removes Heaven's Clarity.

Swordlight Ward
Casting Intro Skill - Tonality Shift or Heavy Attack - Stringblade grants 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=8} of Swordlight Ward.
Swordlight Ward stacks up to 1 {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=9}. When taking DMG from an enemy's attack, 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=A} of Swordlight Ward can be consumed to grant immunity to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Sword Flight
While in the Sword Flight state, Qingxiao moves with a special animation.
Moving in Sword Flight continuously consumes Flight Qi.
- Casting the following skills sends Qingxiao into the Sword Flight state:
Sword Glide, Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 1, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 2, Severing Note: Ascendant, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, and Intro Skill - Tonality Shift.
- Exit the Sword Flight state by:
1. Casting Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3 or Plunging Attack.
2. Triggering certain environmental interactions or Utilities.
3. Returning to the ground.
4. Switching to another Resonator.
5. Depleting all Flight Qi.

Sword Step
While in the Sword Flight state, hold Jump to leap up and dash forward a short distance.
Sword Step can only be cast once during Sword Flight.

Qin Heart
Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with Sheathed Stance skills grants Qin Heart.
Qin Heart cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Sword Cadence
Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with Drawn Stance skills grants Sword Cadence.
Sword Cadence cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Heart Sword Intent
Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence or Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence grants Heart Sword Intent.

清宵技能造成伤害后，对目标附加【集谐·偏移】，每次技能对同一目标只能触发1次。
清宵拥有响应【集谐·干涉】的能力。
响应【集谐·干涉】：目标每有一层【集谐·干涉】效果，清宵自身的每点谐度破坏增幅会使自身对该目标造成的最终伤害提升0.12%。清宵在编队中时，目标的【集谐·干涉】效果的层数上限增加1层。
此外，目标【偏谐值】满时，清宵可对其施放【谐度破坏】。处于地面且不处于昙体仙身状态时，施放【谐度破坏】后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻·弦剑第3段。
skills.descEn:
Qingxiao inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target after dealing damage with skills. Each skill can only trigger this once for the same target.
Qingxiao can respond to Tune Strain - Interfered.
Responding to Tune Strain - Interfered: For each stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, every point of Qingxiao's Tune Break Boost increases the total DMG Qingxiao deals to that target by 0.12%. While Qingxiao is in the team, the max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered on a target is increased by 1.
Additionally, when the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Qingxiao can cast Tune Break on it. While on the ground and not in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Tune Break to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

inherents.name: 识海浩渺，尘世万千
inherents.nameEn: Sea of Thought, World of Dust
inherents.desc:
进入战斗时，获得1层【凝识】。

队伍中的角色直接造成的伤害击败带有心识锁定效果的目标后：
如果清宵没有【凝识】效果，则获得【凝识】效果，且层数与目标的心识锁定层数相同。
如果清宵已有【凝识】效果，且目标的心识锁定层数不小于清宵的【凝识】层数，则使清宵的【凝识】层数变为与目标的心识锁定层数相同。

【凝识】
队伍中的角色对目标造成伤害后，将附加等同清宵的【凝识】层数的心识锁定，该效果对同一目标只能触发1次。
队伍中的角色施放【谐度破坏】时，如果目标有【集谐·偏移】效果，将额外附加1层【集谐·干涉】，该效果对同一目标只能触发1次。
清宵失去意识时，不会继续获得【凝识】效果，同时已有的【凝识】效果失效。
【凝识】层数上限为15，持续30秒。

inherents.name: 通晓万物，指名破祟
inherents.desc:
清宵以下技能对拥有心识锁定的目标造成伤害提升，每层提升2%，前7层每层额外提升5%。
·重击·弦剑、普攻·昙体仙身、闪避反击·昙体仙身、重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身、共鸣解放·天光云影沧澜兴。

每次队伍中的角色对怒涛级或海啸级目标附加【集谐·干涉】后，对目标额外附加1层心识锁定。

chains.name: 起若流云聚还散
chains.nameEn: Like Clouds That Meet and Drift Apart
chains.desc:
暴击提升16%。

护体剑光层数上限提升至2层，施放重击·弦剑时，可额外获得1层护体剑光。

进入战斗后，获得25层的清邪剑诀。
普攻·弦剑、空中攻击·弦剑、普攻·昙体仙身造成伤害后，若拥有清邪剑诀，将移除清邪剑诀，触发巨阙灭迹，造成清宵攻击400%的气动伤害，本次伤害为普攻伤害，该效果每秒最多触发1次。每移除一层清邪剑诀，使目标受到巨阙灭迹伤害提升4%，该效果持续2秒。
清邪剑诀层数上限为25。
chains.descEn:
Crit. Rate is increased by 16%.

The max stack limit of Swordlight Ward is increased to 2. Casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade additionally grants 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Swordlight Ward.

Upon entering combat, gain 25 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=3} of Exorcising Seal.
After Basic Attack - Stringblade, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade, or Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence deals damage, if Qingxiao has Exorcising Seal, remove all Exorcising Seal stacks and trigger Juque Perdition, dealing Aero DMG equal to 400% of Qingxiao's ATK, considered Basic Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered up to once per second. For each stack of Exorcising Seal removed, the target takes 4% more DMG from Juque Perdition for 2s.
Exorcising Seal stacks up to 25 times.

chains.name: 罢如素英落无声
chains.nameEn: Like Petals That Fall Without a Sound
chains.desc:
重击·弦剑伤害倍率提升40%。

进入战斗状态后，附近敌人的心识锁定层数上限提升至25。
固有技能·识海浩渺，尘世万千的【凝识】层数上限提升至25。

天心空明效果强化：
施放重击·弦剑时，对附近的目标附加的心识锁定层数提升至6层。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack - Stringblade is increased by 40%.

After entering combat, the max stack limit of Mindlock on nearby enemies is increased to 25.
The max stack limit of Gathered Mind from Inherent Skill - Sea of Thought, World of Dust is increased to 25.

Heaven's Clarity is enhanced:
Casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade now inflicts 6 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=3} of Mindlock on nearby targets.

chains.name: 长梦无痕剑留影
chains.desc:
共鸣解放·天光云影沧澜兴暴击伤害提升100%。

施放重击·弦剑期间，根据附近敌人心识锁定的最高层数，获得同等层数的万物和鸣。
万物和鸣：每层使重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身伤害倍率提升3%。施放重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身后移除万物和鸣。

固有技能·识海浩渺，尘世万千的【凝识】效果附加【集谐·干涉】层数提升至2层。
chains.descEn:
The Crit. DMG of Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven is increased by 100%.

During Heavy Attack - Stringblade, gain World in Chorus stacks equal to the highest Mindlock stack count present among nearby enemies.
World in Chorus: Each stack increases the DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence by 3%. World in Chorus is removed after casting Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence.

The Gathered Mind effect of Inherent Skill - Sea of Thought, World of Dust now inflicts 2 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Tune Strain - Interfered.

chains.name: 红尘杳渺且偕行
chains.nameEn: Wherever the Road Leads, Side by Side
chains.desc: 队伍中的角色附加【集谐·偏移】后，该角色攻击提升20%，持续8秒。
chains.descEn: After a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting, their ATK is increased by 20% for 8s.

chains.name: 寒芒愿暖凡间雪
chains.nameEn: Cold Steel That Longs to Warm the Snow
chains.desc:
共鸣技能·浮声一刹·行罚伤害倍率提升100%。

御剑飞行移动时，【御剑气劲】消耗降低30%。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement is increased by 100%.

While moving in Sword Flight, Flight Qi cost is reduced by 30%.

chains.name: 涤荡浊岁天地清
chains.nameEn: Cleanse This Tarnished Age, Till All Runs Clear
chains.desc:
目标受到清宵的重击·弦剑、重击·天钧荡煞·昙体仙身、共鸣解放·天光云影沧澜兴、巨阙灭迹伤害提升40%。

施放重击·弦剑期间，根据附近敌人心识锁定的最高层数，获得同等层数的清邪剑诀。

目标每拥有1层心识锁定，受到巨阙灭迹伤害加深2%，前7层每层额外加深5%。

解锁固有技能·通晓万物，指名破祟后，巨阙灭迹对拥有心识锁定的目标造成伤害提升，每层提升2%，前7层每层额外提升5%。

清宵响应【集谐·干涉】效果提升20%。
chains.descEn:
Targets take 40% more DMG from Qingxiao's Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven, and Juque Perdition.

During Heavy Attack - Stringblade, gain Exorcising Seal stacks equal to the highest Mindlock stack count present among nearby enemies.

For each stack of Mindlock on the target, the DMG of Juque Perdition taken by the target is Amplified by 2%. The first 7 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=3} additionally grant 5% DMG Amplification.

When Inherent Skill - To Know, To Banish is unlocked, the DMG of Juque Perdition on targets with Mindlock is increased by 2% for each stack of Mindlock. The first 7 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} additionally grant 5% DMG increase.

The effect of Qingxiao's response to Tune Strain - Interfered is increased by 20%.
